subject.title: feat(onboarding): recommend plugins and skills from installed apps

question: Should onboarding transmit installed-app metadata to the configured model and ClawHub before the user explicitly consents?
rationale: The code can implement several safe variants, but choosing disclosure-only default-on scanning versus an opt-in privacy boundary is a product and trust decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Consent Before Transmission
options.body: Scan locally, show a concise explanation, require confirmation before external matching, and send app labels without bundle IDs.

options.title: Disable By Default
options.body: Keep the feature behind an explicit wizard setting or onboarding choice that defaults off for existing and new users.

options.title: Accept Disclosure-Only Default
options.body: Retain default-on transmission but disclose every transmitted field and explicitly accept the resulting privacy boundary.

recommendation.title: Consent Before Transmission
recommendation.body: Scan locally, show a concise explanation, require confirmation before external matching, and send app labels without bundle IDs.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR identifies this behavior as a deliberate onboarding product decision and the owner is self-assigned.
